mandatoryCriteria: Picker privacy: Purpose assignee returns only workspace owner and active managers/members; viewers and removed members are excluded
Mention privacy: Purpose mention returns workspace owner and active managers/members/viewers; removed members are excluded
Sibling project isolation: Users who are only members of sibling projects are NEVER returned in people pickers
Boundary enforcement: Non-project members querying project people receive 404 NOT_FOUND
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Project people directory, mention/assignee filtering, and sibling privacy. Out-of-scope: Global user search.
